interface.signature: s1: str, n1: int, s2: str, n2: int -> int

preconditions.description: Both strings s1 and s2 are non-empty, and n1 and n2 are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.expression: M == max(0, (n1 * len(s1)) // (len(s2) * n2) * n2) if any(s2 in S1 for S1 in [s1 * n1]) else 0
postconditions.description: M is the maximum integer such that the string S2 (formed by repeating s2 M times) can be obtained by removing characters from S1 (formed by repeating s1 n1 times).

postconditions.expression: M <= n1 * len(s1) // len(s2) if len(s2) > 0 else 0
postconditions.description: M is bounded by the maximum possible repetitions of s2 in S1, considering the total length of S1 and S2.

postconditions.expression: M == 0 if not any(c in s1 for c in s2) else M >= 1
postconditions.description: If s2 contains characters not present in s1, M is 0; otherwise, M is at least 1 if s2 can be formed from s1.
